Submitting work and Assessments created by someone or something else, as if it was your own, is plagiarism and is a form of academic misconduct. This includes Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated content, content written by a third party (e.g. a company, other person, or a friend or family member), and fabricated data.
This includes copying the work of another Student (past or present, from this or another institution),
Students must not copy or attempt to copy from another Student’s work.
improving grammar and syntax in written English without changing meaning;
shortening sentences or paragraphs without changing overall content;
add new content or restructure the work in any way that changes meaning;
develop, alter, or extend ideas, arguments, or explanations;
translate text into, or from, the language being studied; or
Students must not use online or automatic solvers (or similar tools) in an online or take-home Examination unless specifically permitted by the rubric or other module instructions.
